question.prompt: Name a subject of a Mandela effect—something that groups of people famously misremember.

answers.evidence: People reported remembering Mandela dying in prison in the 1980s, although he actually died in 2013.
The article identifies remembering the spelling as “Berenstein” as a shared false memory.
People falsely remember the title being spelled “Looney Toons.”
The article lists a cornucopia in the Fruit of the Loom logo as a shared false memory.
Vader's line is remembered as “Luke, I am your father,” rather than “No, I am your father.”
Mr. Monopoly wearing a monocle is listed as a shared false memory.
People remember a nonexistent 1990s movie called Shazaam starring Sinbad as a genie.
The article identifies the remembered existence and removal of a burglar emoji as a false-memory example.
The article identifies the remembered existence and removal of a seahorse emoji as a false-memory example.

answers.canonical: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
answers.evidence: The Evil Queen's line is remembered as “Mirror, Mirror on the wall,” although she says “Magic Mirror on the wall.”
The article lists Pikachu having a black tip on its tail as a shared false memory.
Some people remember the clock remaining stopped since the 1980 bombing, although it was permanently stopped in 1996.

question.explanation: The Mandela effect refers to a false memory shared by many people. Examples include altered brand spellings, misquoted movie dialogue, remembered visual details, and even a movie that never existed.
question.criteria: A character, brand, film, quotation, event, or object explicitly identified as a shared false-memory example in the supplied article's “Mandela Effect” section.

provenance.brief: Name something many people famously misremember (a Mandela effect).

quotes.Nelson Mandela: who reported having vivid and detailed memories of news coverage of South African anti-apartheid leader and President Nelson Mandela's (after whom the effect was named) dying in prison in the 1980s.
quotes.Fruit of the Loom: The logo of clothing brand Fruit of the Loom containing a cornucopia
quotes.Darth Vader: Darth Vader telling Luke Skywalker, "Luke, I am your father" in the climax of The Empire Strikes Back (he instead says "No, I am your father")
quotes.Shazaam: The existence of a 1990s movie titled Shazaam starring comedian Sinbad as a genie
quotes.Burglar emoji: The existence (and removal) of a burglar or seahorse emoji
quotes.Seahorse emoji: The existence (and removal) of a burglar or seahorse emoji
quotes.Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs: The Evil Queen's saying "Mirror, Mirror on the wall" in Disney's 1937 movie Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (she actually says "Magic Mirror on the wall")
quotes.Pikachu: Pikachu from Pokémon having a black tip on the end of its tail
quotes.Bologna station clock: The Bologna station clock in Italy was permanently stopped in 1996 to commemorate the time of a 1980 bombing; some locals have the collective false memory of it having been stopped since 1980
